## Overview
Here, the genome-wide frequency of somatic copy number alterations in the TCGA high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) cohort is reproduced. Frequencies of copy number amplifications (AMP; green) and homozygous deletions (HOMDEL; purple) were obtained from the TCGA Ovarian Serous Cystadenocarcinoma PanCancer Atlas cohort through [cBioPortal](https://www.cbioportal.org/study/summary?id=ov_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018) (n = 572; see [References](#references)).

## Load libraries
```{r load libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(SpatialCopyInference)
```

## Import data
```{r Import data, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Import TCGA data
TCGA <- read.delim("Data/CNA_Genes.txt")

# Rename columns
colnames(TCGA) <- c("Gene", "Gistic_Q", "Cytoband", "CNA",
    "ProfiledSamples", "N", "Freq", "CancerGene")
```

## Gene level copy number frequencies
```{r TCGA frequencies, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "100%", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
# Import packaged annotation data
data("hg38_gene_info", package = "SpatialCopyInference")
data("hg38_chrom_info", package = "SpatialCopyInference")

# Merge
TCGA_annot <- TCGA %>%
    left_join(
    hg38_gene_info,
    by = c("Gene" = "hgnc_symbol")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        freq = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", Freq)),
        plot_freq = ifelse(CNA %in% c("DEL", "HOMDEL"),
                           -freq,
                           freq)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(cum_mid))

# Smooth 2mb bins
bin_size <- 2e6

plot_df <- TCGA_annot %>%
    mutate(
        bin = floor(cum_mid / bin_size)
    ) %>%
    group_by(bin, CNA) %>%
    summarise(
        pos = mean(cum_mid),
        freq = mean(freq),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

# Supplementary Figure 3: Genome-wide frequency of somatic copy number alterations in TCGA HGSOC cohort
ggplot() +
    geom_area(
        data = plot_df %>%
            filter(CNA %in% c("AMP", "GAIN")),
        aes(
            x = pos,
            y = freq,
            fill = "AMP"
        ),
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_area(
        data = plot_df %>%
            filter(CNA %in% c("DEL", "HOMDEL")),
        aes(
            x = pos,
            y = -freq,
            fill = "HOMDEL"
        ),
        alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        name = "CNA",
        values = c(
            "AMP" = "#8dd3c7",
            "HOMDEL" = "#bebada"
        )
    ) +
    geom_vline(
        xintercept = hg38_chrom_info$cum_centromere_mid,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_vline(
        xintercept = hg38_chrom_info$cum_length,
        linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = hg38_chrom_info$cum_chromosome_mid,
        labels = gsub(
            "chr",
            "",
            hg38_chrom_info$chrom
        ),
        expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(-35, 35),
        breaks = c(-30, -20, -10, 0, 10, 20, 30)
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Chromosome",
        y = "Frequency (%)"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
```
